comment: Pipeline registry consumed by scripts/auto_update.py. Each entry describes one refresh pipeline: how to invoke it, on what schedule, and what to do with its output. Schedules are evaluated by the cron entry that runs auto_update.py with --schedule=<level>. type=python entries are imported in-process; type=tsx entries are subprocessed via npx tsx. The `targets` array on each pipeline (and the top-level `editorial` list) is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for which src/data/*.ts files are accounted for — scripts/evals/coverage-audit/check.ts fails CI if any data file is neither a pipeline target nor an editorial entry, or if a target/editorial path no longer exists. Keep targets in sync with each pipeline's emit.ts.

pipelines.label: Singapore Parliament Hansard
pipelines.description: SPRS API scan for AI-related debates. Existing pipeline.

pipelines.label: YouTube AI videos
pipelines.description: Daily auto-PR: python scan (RSS+HTML, merge-writes candidates.json) → emit.ts (LLM bilingual fields + 4-language transcript chain + i18n gate) → commit → PR. Daily because CNA/ST publish 30+ vids/day and the scrape window covers <24h. Was scan-only-email + manual emit until 2026-07-28 (audit P1: lost videos twice).

pipelines.label: Ministry speeches (MDDI/MAS/PMO)
pipelines.description: Ministry speech scan (MDDI + MAS + PMO sitemaps, 2026-08 expansion) + page fetch + Claude haiku translation (zh paragraphs, zh+en tldr) + trilingual title/event/speakerTitle. New sources floor at >=2026-01-01 (rejected-ids.json cache). Emits to voices.ts mddiSpeeches[] + speech-transcripts.ts speechTranscripts map.

pipelines.label: GitHub stars refresh
pipelines.description: Pull live stargazer counts and bump dataDate. Rewrites stars on existing GitHub blocks only (no new-repo discovery).

pipelines.label: Government AI policies
pipelines.description: Scan smartnation/MAS/IMDA/PDPC/AIVerify for new AI advisories.

pipelines.label: Ecosystem entities
pipelines.description: Scan e27/tech.gov.sg for new SG AI startups & government products. Auto-added entries marked _pendingReview.

pipelines.label: AI levers
pipelines.description: Scan IMDA/tech.gov.sg/EDB for new programmes / funds / data centre deals.

pipelines.label: AI startups
pipelines.description: Business Times tech RSS + AISG + EDB; surface funding rounds, exits, new SG AI companies.

pipelines.label: Legal framework
pipelines.description: Monitor sso.agc.gov.sg / MAS / PDPC for new AI-related legislation & regulatory guidance.

pipelines.label: AI talent programmes
pipelines.description: AISG / IMDA / GovTech for new training, scholarship, apprentice, K-12 AI education programmes.

pipelines.label: National AI tracker (6 dimensions)
pipelines.description: Surface new investment / talent / compute / adoption / research / governance data points.

pipelines.label: International benchmarking
pipelines.description: Stanford AI Index + IMD WCY for new annual reports; flag for manual data extraction.

pipelines.label: AI Jobs Index (MyCareersFuture)
pipelines.description: Monthly aggregate snapshot of live AI job postings: uuid-dedup'd count across a frozen query basket, salary percentiles (disclosed Monthly ranges only), top-10 employers, role-type mix. Aggregates only — no listing republication. History is unrecoverable, so the sanity bound refuses implausibly small sweeps rather than corrupt the immutable series. Surfaces: /talent demand-side section + a render-time-derived /tracker talent metric.

pipelines.label: Regulatory lookahead (consultations + bills)
pipelines.description: Weekly lifecycle tracker for the pipeline BEFORE the law: open AI-relevant public consultations (IMDA/PDPC/MDDI sitemaps) and bills moving through Parliament (fixture-pinned parser of bills-introduced). New records appended; stage/status transitions edited IN PLACE with observation history — the git diff is the review surface. DIB-class events become day-1-week-1 captures instead of the ~4-week miss of 2026-07. Renders as /legal-ai #reg-lookahead.

pipelines.label: SG AI research monthly digest (OpenAlex)
pipelines.description: Previous-month SG-institution AI works from OpenAlex (~600) → deterministic prefilter (SG first-author or ≥0.3 SG share) + venue/citation ranking → sonnet triage picks 5-10 notable papers → one 4-language FieldNote on /fieldnotes. PR body lists chosen AND near-miss papers so triage quality is phone-reviewable. Thin months (<3 picks) skip rather than pad.

pipelines.label: Evals: URL health + i18n coverage (Layer A) + updates ledger
pipelines.description: Sweep every sourceUrl/url in src/data/*.ts and assert reachability; assert all CJK string fields have *En + *Ja siblings; assert every commit that net-added records to a tracked data file also surfaced an entry on src/data/updates.ts. Layers B/C/D need a build and run via `npm run build && npm run eval` separately.

pipelines.label: Evals (monthly): AI summary + Translation golden regressions
pipelines.description: LLM-backed quality regressions. Runs scripts/lib/ai-summarize.ts and scripts/lib/translate.ts against golden corpus; asserts schema validity, classification closed-set, length bands, term hits, glossary fidelity, language purity. Cost: ~30 Claude haiku calls (~few cents). Issue opens if any case fails an assertion.

editorialComment: src/data/*.ts files with NO refresh pipeline that are legitimately human-edited or derived. coverage-audit treats these as accounted-for. Adding a new data file means either giving some pipeline a `targets` entry for it or adding it here with a reason.

editorial.reason: 大事年表，半事件半编辑，重大里程碑时手动追加
外部资源索引，看到好文章手工加
人物档案，靠 scripts/voices/prospect-stubs.mjs 半自动 review queue（季度手动 promote），非全自动管线
政策原文全文缓存，policies 详情页消费，手工维护
首页『最近更新』从各数据文件的 addedAt 派生（src/utils/derived-updates.ts），只剩 site/fix/longform 手动 override，非刷新目标
受控主题词表（15 个，/topics hub 的 taxonomy），产品级词表人工维护，非内容 record（无 addedAt）
枚举→topicIds 派生映射表 + 解析器，随词表人工维护；verify-graph 校验其值域与枚举完备性
首页头条编辑指针（FEATURED），只引用既有 record 的 id，不是内容 record，无 addedAt/i18n 字段
